x: Ginty, our new acquisition, was fourth, closely followed by the Nichols Bros., of Surrey. Footer (7th) was evidently feeling the effects of a recent change of occupation.

Scarsbrook beat his club-mate, Nichols, by inches in a stirring finish to the 2 miles event (Captain's Match), and another excellent performance, considering the conditions, was that of George Powell, who threw the Javeli 155 ft. 6½ ins.
